title: First-principles calculations of the photocatalytic performance of ZnO–MX2 (M = Mo, W; X = S, Se) heterojunctions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23489-23498
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03215F, Paper
Open Access

Meng-Yao Dai, Xue Wen, Rui Xia, Yi-Min Zheng, Lai Wei, Li-Li Zhang, Xiao-Hui Liang, Yi-Neng Huang
We investigate the charge separation mechanisms in ZnO–MX2 (M = Mo, W; X = S, Se) heterojunctions. Distinct type-I/type-II characteristics and dielectric polarization variations are observed, where ZnO–WS2 exhibit enhanced charge separation and dual OER/HER activity.
